Original reproducer site/tests/unit/redteam-RT-09-p5-t12-claims.test.ts on head: its two P5-RT-09-01 tests fail at their first expect, which looks for the false text. D4 node 2 gives "expected 'Some position has the number 2 at nod…' to contain 'Firing node 2 permutes the positions:…'". B3 node 1 gives "expected 'Firing node 1 permutes the positions:…' to contain 'so the signed matrix is no longer the…'". So the false claims are no longer printed. As the fixer says, this reproducer asserts the claim and the engine verdict together and can never pass. The 3 regressions in T12.test.ts (comments 'regression: P5-RT-09-01') pass. Oracle check: I dumped the server render and signedNote(k, largestAt) for all 163 nodes of the 32 boards and compared 892 (node, k) states against minuscule_matrices and signed_moves. The identity text appears in 442 states, and in all of them S_k = E+F+P0, (I+E)(I-F)(I+E) equals the signed matrix, its square is (-1)^H and the signed matrix equals S_k up to sign. The failure text appears in 450 states, where both identities are false and some position has the number m at node k. The 59 states on nodes that are not minuscule where the identities hold now get the identity text. 0 mismatches; the server panel equals signedNote at k = i on every node. In the browser (hydrated, each matrix-node chosen) B3 1, C3 3, D4 2, G2 1, F4 4 and A4 2 all match the oracle. The text uses only terms of Appendix C and M8 and contains no em-dash. Scratch revert: I replaced {@html signedNote(...)} in the Svelte file with the fcb02a5 paragraph: 3 failed (D4 {moveIsEFP:true...} vs false; B3 'expected true to be false'; B2 node 1 mismatch). File restored.
